reserves.name: Staked ZANO in the Freedom Dollar reserve wallet
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Freedom Dollar DAO reserve contract stakers (ZANO)

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's live dashboard was opened on 2026-09-21 and carried its own 2026-09-21 08:28:33 timestamp. It disclosed 1,375,148.82 ZANO at $8.185, 5,222,687 fUSD held in the reserve wallet, 7.1M circulating fUSD, 12.3M minted fUSD, $11,255,593.07 of stated public reserves, and a stated 1.59x coverage ratio. The issuer also publishes a view-only tracking seed for direct observation of the ZANO reserve wallet. The reserve-held fUSD is the protocol's own uncirculated supply rather than exogenous collateral, so the backing composition resolves to one ZANO category.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves sit in an on-chain ZANO wallet staked on Zano rather than with a legal custodian, and the white paper asserts no corporate entity exists. The reserve wallet's key custody (single operator vs distributed control) is not publicly observable, and no legal segregation, insolvency-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms are published.
